newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ZIDANE TO MISS JUVENTUS-VICENZA MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-ZIDANE TO MISS JUVENTUS-VICENZA MATCH.

text.p: French international midfielder Zinedine Zidane was ruled out of Juventus' league match against Vicenza at the weekend after Italy's serie A sporting judge upheld a one-match ban against him.
Zidane was booked in the league leaders' 1-1 draw at Fiorentina on Sunday and was handed a one match suspension on Wednesday for the accumulation of cautions against him.
His French midfield team mate Didier Deschamps is also almost certain to miss the match because of injury while Croat Alen Boksic's return from injury is doubtful.
Elsewhere in serie A, the sporting judge banned Milan's Paolo Maldini and French international Christophe Dugarry for two matches after both were sent off at the weekend.

Italy captain Maldini, usually one of the calmest of players, and Dugarry were shown red cards in the first half of Milan's 1-0 defeat by Perugia for blatant elbowing. Milan play Roma at home on Sunday.
